lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 16 — Timothy Joins Paul / Lydia / Prison in Philippi

questions.questionText: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where a disciple named who lived?
My mother was Jewish and a believer; my father was a Greek. Who am I?
The believers at Lystra and Iconium spoke well of Timothy. What did Paul do?
options: He wanted to take him along and circumcised him because of the Jews

questions.questionText: As they traveled they delivered the decisions from Jerusalem. What happened to the churches?
options: They were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in numbers

questions.questionText: The Holy Spirit kept them from preaching the word in which province?
They tried to enter Bithynia, but whom would not allow them?
They passed by Mysia and went down to where?
Paul had a vision of a man from where begging him to come?
After the vision they got ready at once to leave for Macedonia, concluding what?
options: That God had called them to preach the gospel there

questions.questionText: From Troas they sailed to Samothrace then to Neapolis and on to which leading city?
On the Sabbath they went outside the city gate to the river looking for a place of prayer. Who listened?
options: Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from Thyatira

questions.questionText: Who opened Lydia’s heart to respond?
When she and the members of her household were baptized, what did she invite?
options: Come and stay at my house

questions.questionText: I was a female slave with a spirit by which I predicted the future. Who am I?
What did she earn for her owners?
She followed Paul shouting, These men are servants of the Most High God. How many days?
Paul became so annoyed he said to the spirit, In the name of Jesus Christ I command you to come out. When did it leave?
When her owners realized their hope of making money was gone, what did they do?
options: They seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace

questions.questionText: They told the magistrates these men are Jews and are throwing our city into an uproar. What did the crowd do?
The magistrates ordered them to be stripped and beaten. Where were they thrown?
options: Into prison, the inner cell, feet in stocks

questions.questionText: About midnight Paul and Silas were doing what?
options: Praying and singing hymns to God

questions.questionText: Suddenly what happened?
options: A violent earthquake; prison doors flew open; chains came loose

questions.questionText: I woke up, saw the doors open, and drew my sword to kill myself. Who am I?
Who shouted, Don’t harm yourself! We are all here!
The jailer asked, Sirs, what must I do to be saved? What did they say?
options: Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household

questions.questionText: The jailer washed their wounds. Then what?
options: He and all his household were baptized

questions.questionText: The jailer fed them and was filled with what?
options: Joy because he had come to believe in God

questions.questionText: When daylight came the magistrates sent officers to say what?
options: Send them to Rome at once

questions.questionText: Paul said they beat us publicly without a trial, even though we are what?
When the magistrates heard they were Roman citizens they were what?
The magistrates escorted them from the prison and requested what?
After leaving the prison they went to whose house?
True or false: Other prisoners were listening to Paul and Silas sing.
options: True — but they slept through the earthquake

questions.questionText: I deal in purple cloth and I am from Thyatira. Who am I?
I am a Roman colony and leading city of that district of Macedonia. What city?
They stayed in Philippi how many days at first?
True or false: Timothy was well spoken of in Lystra and Iconium.
Who joined the narrative as we at Troas?
options: The writer traveling with them (we got ready)

questions.questionText: They were forbidden to preach in Asia and not allowed into which place next?
Lydia was a worshiper of God. After baptism she said if you consider me a believer then what?
Paul wanted to take Timothy with him. What did he do because of the Jews in that area?
The churches were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in what?
Paul and his companions traveled throughout the region of Phrygia and where?
They passed by Mysia and went down to which seaport before sailing to Macedonia?
Who joined Paul at Troas as a traveling companion in the “we” story?
After the earthquake, the jailer asked, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?” What did they answer?
True or false: The magistrates came to apologize and escorted Paul and Silas from the prison.
options: They sent soldiers to kill them
